correctness.rationale: Necessity follows from adjacent-positive inconsistency and a forced-domination chain along 2,3*,2. Sufficiency is an independent neighbor-witness construction: gaps >=4 decouple blocks, each 3-only block contains at most one gap 2 and hence supports a consistent uniform neighbor direction for any labels; greedy maximal extension preserves forbidden negatives. The binomial sum follows from rooted long-gap separators, one-short-gap-per-block generating series, stars and bars, and the n/k cyclic-label factor. Exhaustive independent trace computation through n=18 and boundary identities through n=90 corroborate the arguments.

value.rationale: All-degree shattering polynomial and a complete forbidden-gap recognition theorem for a natural nonhereditary graph concept class. This enumerates every coordinate support, rather than only the concept count (Perrin numbers) or VC maximum, gives a sharp n/(3) dimension law and exactly n maximum faces at n=3k-1, and reveals a cyclic obstruction not determined by path results. These are natural learning-theoretic invariants with reproducible finite checking.
